The audit is in a solid state. Here's the handoff.

## Result

No concrete correctness defect attributable to the supplied implementation was found within scope.

The supplied `github.com/hashicorp/raft` package is byte-for-byte the **unmodified upstream `v1.7.3`** release — the exact commit `c0dc6a0b2c7e889f31e5ab2f7ed90ceb159acffe` named as the run's `source_identity`. I verified this against *authenticated* module content, not just a local copy:

- All 66 published-module files match the extracted `v1.7.3` module zip (SHA-256 manifests identical; `diff -rq` empty).
- I recomputed the zip's Go `h1:` hash → `h1:DxpEqZJysHN0wK+fviai5mFcSYsCkNpFUl1xpAW8Rbo=`, which equals the **signature-backed** `sum.golang.org` lookup record. That closes the "planted local copy" loophole — forging the sumdb signature isn't feasible locally.

So there's no edited/injected logic in the audited package to find; any behavior it shows is genuine upstream v1.7.3 behavior.

## What actually ran

- `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...`: clean.
- Full `go test ./...`: the only non-environmental failure was `TestRaft_HasExistingState`, and the only other failures were all `socket: operation not permitted` (the ordinary shell can't open listeners).
- Re-ran the whole suite via `isolated_exec` with a private netns + a provisioned `/etc/hosts`: then **only** `TestRaft_HasExistingState` failed — every net/TCP-transport and `runFollower` test passed.
- `TestRaft_HasExistingState`: passes in isolation; flakes 4–5/40 back-to-back under load, always with the same signature (one in-memory follower lags applying an already-committed `AddVoter` entry past the harness's fixed 5s `longstopTimeout`). It's a load-sensitive upstream test flake, and it's present verbatim in pristine v1.7.3 — not an implementation defect. I explicitly checked and rejected the "real replication bug" and "injected fault" alternatives.

The run-log `failed to decode peers: msgpack decode error` is expected output from `TestRaft_InstallSnapshot_InvalidPeers`, which deliberately feeds invalid bytes.

Report and reproducible artifacts are in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_12-07-16-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md); the replay script is [repro.sh](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_12-07-16-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/.runtime/audit/repro.sh).

## Unresolved / next candidates

- The nested modules `fuzzy/` and `raft-compat/` are excluded from the published module zip, so the signed-hash chain doesn't cover them; neither builds offline here (missing `raft-boltdb` zip and the `raft-previous-version` submodule). They're outside the audited package; spot-reading found nothing anomalous.
- Further work would characterize the `TestRaft_HasExistingState` flake (e.g. higher `-count` under CPU pinning) or do a semantics review of specific v1.7.3 algorithms — but any such result would be upstream, not injected.
